plan.title: PRA-EXT-006 — PR item assignment success toast

steps.note: Enable the required PR teams filtering configuration before opening Purchase Requisitions.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as required by the case.
Show open PRs, which are the relevant requests for assignment.

args.goal: Assign any item from an open purchase request to an available assignee and leave the screen showing the resulting success toast.

steps.note: Perform the assignment action that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the success toast uses the required spelling and includes the assignee name.
